summary: The test suite has strong unit tests (labeler.test.ts, cli.test.ts) with comprehensive coverage of core functionality and good edge cases, plus well-structured workflow validation tests. However, it violates a critical task requirement: the task explicitly states 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' and 'Do NOT test your script directly — all testing goes through the pipeline.' The provided unit tests run locally via bun test, not through the workflow. The act-harness (act-harness.ts) properly validates integration through the workflow but covers only 3 test cases, leaving minimal end-to-end coverage. While the act-harness itself is well-designed with clear fixture setup and output validation, the overall test architecture fails to comply with the explicit all-tests-through-act requirement. To meet the task, unit tests should be either incorporated into the act-harness (producing many act-driven cases) or eliminated in favor of comprehensive act-based testing only. This is a fundamental design flaw despite solid individual test quality.
